backend_visibility: oo_target_owner is NOINHERIT. install_full_import grants pg_read_all_stats WITH INHERIT TRUE, SET FALSE so the security-definer fence can read the caller backend_start. 0005 refuses unless that usage is present. Runtime and Agent are not members. The grant is not the fence.
fence: one target connection holds the shard advisory lock, owner, generation, and backend identity for every write and commit
replay: same batch id and same payload digest is not a second copy; a different payload aborts the data, quality, and receipt transaction with OO010
recovery: an ambiguous commit is resolved by the stored receipt identity
